analysis: The candidate does implement the claimed watch-target construction, custom model head, and mixed censored watch loss with real gradient consumers, and it does not use watch-time as an inference feature. However, fail-closed applies because predictions are still produced by opaque delegated SO.predict on a custom model class outside the trusted backend contract, so executable prediction change is not evidenced. Additionally, the custom replacement introduces its own best-train-loss checkpoint rule without contract support, creating an undeclared runtime behavior change.
